metadata.policy: A partner is a PERSON, not a vibe. Partner photo pools draw ONLY on brand-approved Kodiak DAM photography of that person (licensed shoots, partnership deliverables). No scraped video stills, no fan photos, no likeness synthesis — scraped frames carry no consent trail and fail on quality/provenance. Gaps in the shot list are filled by booking/licensing shoots, never by generating the person's face.

collabs.conservation: Proceeds support The Vital Ground Foundation (bear habitat protection).

cutouts.policy: Approved transparent-background (RGB-A) photos of the person, cut by the brand team from licensed stills with the partnership grant covering derivative composites. No frames pulled from video without clearance; no generative fill of the person.

zac-efron.role: Chief Brand Officer and board member, shareholder
